message.content:
This illustration on an orange background features two figures on a single, two-headed horse. The horse has a brown, glossy coat, four legs, and two heads facing opposite directions. Each head has a bridle and reins. On its back sits a figure in white clothing with a red neckerchief, holding a curved dagger with a wavy blade and a wooden hilt upward. Behind this figure, another in a light-colored shirt and dark trousers sits facing the opposite direction, holding onto reins. Both have black hair and are looking outward.

Large white text at the top reads "TEMPO" with smaller white text below: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Black text at the upper left states: "RUDIANTARA: SAYA TAK RAGU MEMBLOKIR FACEBOOK." To the right, black text says: "RIBUT-RIBUT KUDA TROYA KPK." On the left, bold black text reads: "PERSEKUTUAN GANJIL JOKOWI-PRABOWO." Below this is a block of smaller black text starting with "DEKLARASI KETUA UMUM PARTAI GERINDRA..." and ending with "...RAYUAN INKUMBEN." A barcode with numbers and the date "23-29 APRIL 2018" are in the lower-left corner.
